2610.13516.title: RESCUE: Is This Alarm Worth Acting On? Counterfactual Evaluation of VLA Runtime Monitors
2610.13516.paper_summary: Runtime failure monitors for robot policies are typically evaluated by how accurately they distinguish failed from successful executions. Yet an accurate alarm may arrive too late for recovery, while an unnecessary intervention may disrupt an execution that would otherwise succeed. We introduce RESCUE, a counterfactual framework for evaluating whether a monitor's alarms enable useful interventions. By restoring simulator and policy states at execution checkpoints, RESCUE compares alternative actions, identifies the latest checkpoint satisfying a specified recovery criterion, and evaluates whether acting on alarms reduces expected task-completion cost. We evaluate RESCUE with OpenVLA-OFT and $π_{0.5}$ over LIBERO-Spatial and LIBERO-Plus using 128,340 counterfactual branches. Recoverability depends on the state--intervention pair rather than on robot state alone: at $τ=0.5$, 14 of 66 OpenVLA-OFT/LIBERO-Plus failures contain a recoverable checkpoint under continuation, compared with 34 of 66 under continuation or scripted recovery, while recovery reduces recoverability in other conditions. On the primary strong-policy conditions, favourable detection scores do not establish lower intervention cost. Under the evaluated stop-and-reset model, even an idealised detector can afford only a 2.0--3.3% false-alarm rate before unnecessary resets outweigh the savings from stopping failures early. These results show that monitor value depends jointly on the intervention available and the workload in which it is deployed.
2610.13516.paper_summary_zh: 機器人政策的運行時故障監控通常是通過其區分失敗與成功執行的準確性來評估的。<lb/>然而，準確的警報可能會在恢復時過晚到達，而不必要的干預可能會干擾本來會成功的執行。<lb/>我們引入了RESCUE，一個用於評估監控器的警報是否能夠啟用有用干預的反事實框架。<lb/>通過在執行檢查點恢復模擬器和政策狀態，RESCUE比較替代行動，確定滿足特定恢復標準的最新檢查點，並評估根據警報行動是否降低預期的任務完成成本。<lb/>我們使用128,340個反事實分支，對OpenVLA-OFT和$π_{0.5}$在LIBERO-Spatial和LIBERO-Plus上進行了RESCUE的評估。<lb/>可恢復性取決於狀態-干預對，而不僅僅是機器人狀態：在$τ=0.5$時，66個OpenVLA-OFT/LIBERO-Plus故障中有14個在持續執行下包含可恢復的檢查點，而在持續執行或腳本恢復下則有34個，而在其他條件下，恢復會降低可恢復性。<lb/>在主要的強政策條件下，有利的檢測分數並未確立較低的干預成本。<lb/>在評估的停止和重置模型下，即使是理想化的檢測器也只能承受2.0--3.3%的誤報率，否則不必要的重置將超過提前停止故障所帶來的節省。<lb/>這些結果表明，監控器的價值共同依賴於可用的干預和其部署的工作負載。
